section_dispositions.note: Prepend-ordered historical ACT report log at heading level 1. 177 report sections were mechanically indexed by identity, verdict and exact source range into `historical-index.json`. Board provenance header: the source-of-truth statement (`Source-of-truth: .factory/epics/*.md` — the per-epic detail files. **This board is a navigation index, not an archive.**), the contract link, the conservation anchor `5e96cfd3a`, and the size cap. Navigation and metadata, not an epic.

The Current frontier table — 21 lanes with their state and NEXT. This is the operational index the migration's frontier records are reconciled from. Lanes recorded CLOSED / CLOSED_STRUCTURAL / CLOSED_V2 carry no current obligation; lanes recorded OPEN / HOLD / ACTIVE do.

The Active epics table — 16 rows. Every epic with an ACTIVE family-level state is represented as an epic record, including the ones whose Frontier column is `(none)`. CLOSED epics are represented as TERMINAL epics and remain discoverable.
The Open supporting work table — 9 cross-cutting rows plus the FWL02 producer row. Each row's Detail link determines the owning epic; the rows are represented in their owning epic's item collection.

The Deferred / hold table — 9 rows. Every row is represented with `lifecycle: DEFERRED` in its owning epic. A DEFERRED row is work the source explicitly postponed; it is not part of the operational frontier.

The Historical task census — a conservation-only ACT-ID listing grouped by family, explicitly "an audit trail, not a status report". The identities it lists are already covered by the historical ACT index; the region is accounted for as narrative history plus the already-indexed ACT identities.

The TRAILING region of the board — the range the previous source accounting stopped at. It is NOT narrative-only: it carries the board's maintenance contract, its status / priority vocabulary, its size invariant and, above all, 205 further ACT report sections at heading level 2 (`## ACT-... — VERDICT — date`). Those 205 sections belong to 149 DISTINCT historical ACT identities that the level-1-only extraction had silently skipped, which is why the previous accounting reported 167 identities. Every one of those identities is now mechanically indexed by identity, verdict and exact source range into `historical-index.json` with its own disposition (289 UNAMBIGUOUS, 2 AMBIGUOUS, 25 CONFLICTING over 316 distinct identities in total). The 25 conflicting identities are surfaced by the SOURCE_CONFLICT reconciliation records; the remainder are accounted for at the COLD level — identity, verdict and exact source range — with their complete original bytes preserved verbatim in the committed source archive. The report bodies and `Updated:` chronology lines inside this range are accounted for as contiguous narrative history at the byte level and are deliberately NOT reconstructed paragraph-by-paragraph as new work items. No outstanding obligation was found in this range that the operational index and the per-epic detail files do not already own; the 149 identities are historical EXECUTIONS, not current obligations.

The frozen maintenance contract: authority hierarchy, closed-class status vocabulary, priority semantics, frontier rules, conservation rules, human-readability rules and link rules.
